ORDER:
The Criminal Petition has been filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 (for brevity 'the BNSS') by the petitioners/Accused Nos.3,4 and 5 for granting of pre-arrest bail in connection with Crime No.237 of 2025 of Nandyal II Town Police Station, Nandyal District,
registered for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 420,406,509,506 r/w 34 IPC, 3(1)(x)
SC ST POA Act, 156(3) Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for brevity 'the Cr.P.C.') Dr. YLR, J Dated 31.12.2025 2.
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor.
3. As seen from the record, the alleged offence leveled against the petitioners are punishable with imprisonment for less than seven (07) years.

4. In this regard, it is apposite to mention the Hon'ble Apex Court in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar1, wherein a detailed guidelines were issued at Para Nos.11 and 12, for arresting a person,
which are being reproduced herein below:-
11.Our endeavor in this judgment is to ensure that police officers do not arrest accused unnecessarily and Magistrate do not authorize detention casually and mechanically.
